china_race_dynamics.text: Right now, America is in an artificial intelligence (AI) arms race with China. [...] And keeping our energy production for electricity, our baseload power production open, will help us win this contest while driving down electricity costs for American families.
china_race_dynamics.context: Senate Appropriations subcommittee hearing on the Department of the Interior's FY 2026 budget, where Interior Secretary Doug Burgum testified.

deepseek.reason: She calls the AI competition with China an arms race and says energy policy will help America win it.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly frames AI policy as a contest with China that the US should win.
